hints.title: Odd Binary Number Property
hints.text: A binary number is odd if and only if its least significant bit (the very last character) is '1'.

hints.title: Greedy Leading Ones
hints.text: To maximize value, place as many '1's as possible at the highest significance (the left).

hints.title: Reserve One Bit
hints.text: Reserve exactly one '1' for the last position. Place all remaining '1's at the beginning, followed by all '0's, and finally the reserved '1'.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumOddBinaryNumber(self, s: str) -> str:
        ones = s.count('1')
        zeros = len(s) - ones
        return '1' * (ones - 1) + '0' * zeros + '1'
```

variables: n: length of binary string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Permuting the string takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space for the reconstructed output string.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Count ones and zeros, placing one '1' at the end and all other '1's at the front.
